user.title: Select the source cover
user.description: Pick the existing cover entity from the Overkiz integration that should get a calculated real-time position.

settings.title: Travel times for {source}
settings.description: The travel time is how long a full run from fully closed to fully open takes. Measure it once with a stopwatch; auto calibration keeps correcting it afterwards.

data_description.source_handling: The realtime entity forwards every command to the original entity, so the original is never disabled or deleted – that would break this integration too. It is only hidden, or additionally renamed.

error.source_is_realtime: This entity was created by this integration already.
error.source_unavailable: This entity currently has no state.

abort.already_configured: A real-time entity already exists for this cover.

data.command_delay: Delay between command and motor start
data.timed_positioning: Reach target position with a timed stop
data.auto_calibration: Keep travel times up to date automatically

data_description.update_interval: Lower values look smoother but produce more state changes.
data_description.command_delay: Time the gateway and the radio link need before the motor actually starts.
data_description.resync_threshold: If the position reported by the gateway deviates more than this, the calculation snaps to it. 100 % disables correction while travelling.
data_description.timed_positioning: Only for devices without position support such as RTS motors: the run is stopped after the calculated time.
data_description.calibration_weight: 1.0 adopts every measurement immediately, small values smooth over many runs.
data_description.source_handling: The realtime entity forwards every command to the original entity, so the original is never disabled or deleted – that would break this integration too. It is only hidden, or additionally renamed.

set_known_position.name: Set known position
set_known_position.description: Sets the calculated position without sending a movement command.

position.name: Position
position.description: Actual position of the cover (0 = closed, 100 = open).

set_travel_times.name: Set travel times
set_travel_times.description: Overrides the travel times at runtime and stores them permanently.

travel_time_up.name: Travel time up
travel_time_up.description: Seconds for a full opening run.

travel_time_down.name: Travel time down
travel_time_down.description: Seconds for a full closing run.

tilt_time_up.name: Tilt time open
tilt_time_up.description: Seconds until the slats are fully open.

tilt_time_down.name: Tilt time closed
tilt_time_down.description: Seconds until the slats are fully closed.

calibrate.name: Calibration run
calibrate.description: Runs the cover end to end and measures the actual travel times.

options.keep: Leave it alone (both entities stay visible)
options.takeover: Hide it and take over its entity ID
